subject: URGENT: Executive Wire Transfer Authorization - Q3 Fiscal Closing

origin.isp: Tor Exit Node Relay / Anonymous Network

ai_summary: High-confidence spear-phishing / Business Email Compromise (BEC) attempt impersonating the CEO Office. The sender domain ('megacorp-finance-portal.com') is a newly registered typosquat (48 hours old). The email originated from a known TOR Exit Node in Moscow. SPF and DKIM signatures failed cryptographic validation with a strict DMARC rejection policy violation. Embedded payload points to an active credential harvesting gateway.

subject: Action Required: Microsoft 365 MFA Token Re-authentication
ai_summary: Suspicious credential harvesting lure designed to mimic official Microsoft 365 identity verification. While the sending server managed to satisfy a lenient SPF record, DKIM key alignment is missing and DMARC enforcement is unenforced. Traffic traces back to a commercial VPN provider in Lagos, Nigeria with historical links to AiTM (Adversary-in-the-Middle) phishing campaigns.
